split_name: Matbench v0.1 official five-fold outer validation

license.scope_note: The upstream Figshare source-data landing page declares MIT. The Materials Project mirror does not embed a machine-readable license in the downloaded artifact.

curation.repeated_measurements: Upstream removed compositions whose reported gaps span more than 0.1 eV; for retained repeats it chose the observed value closest to their mean.
curation.polymorphs: Not identifiable: the task exposes composition only, so structure and polymorph identity are unavailable.
curation.near_identical_structures: Not applicable to the exposed inputs; no structural coordinates are used.
curation.local_duplicate_policy: Retain exact upstream rows only for official benchmark comparability; audit canonical duplicates, keep groups intact in calibration/custom splits, and collapse the fixed candidate pool to one canonical composition while retaining every source ID and target span.

exclusions: No relaxed structures, calculated properties, Materials Project identifiers, or post-synthesis metadata.
No records outside the pinned Matbench artifact.
